verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web chat application accessed via its own login/authentication system, not a bot deployed on external messaging surfaces (Slack, Discord, Telegram, etc.) where sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating would be a meaningful control. Its 'access control' and per-role/group config (docs-33, docs-19) govern web-app user permissions, not inbound message gating on a messaging platform, so this axis is a category mismatch for the product type.
